scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: BNK1CAO set to LOW-VALUES, the cursor on CUSTNO, SEND MAP ERASE; RETURN TRANSID('OCAC') with an initialised COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE, nothing sent; RETURN TRANSID with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE: back to the main menu

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF5: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RM010 -- ABNDPROC LINKed (an ABNDFILE record) and ABEND HBNK

scenarios.name: create-current
scenarios.why: customer 1, CURRENT, 1.5%, overdraft 00000500: EDIT-DATA passes, NUMVAL into a COMP-1 rate, LINK CREACC (INQCUST, INQACCCU in the task, CONTROL 20 -> 21, INSERT ACCOUNT and PROCTRAN): 'The Account has been successfully created', the new sort code / number / dates shown

scenarios.name: create-isa-lower-case
scenarios.why: customer 3, 'isa' typed in lower case: EDIT-DATA's EVALUATE makes it 'ISA'; rate '3.25', overdraft 00000000

scenarios.name: create-mortgage
scenarios.why: MORTGAGE for customer 1, a whole-number rate

scenarios.name: create-loan-mixed
scenarios.why: 'loan' with a two-place rate and overdraft 00001000

scenarios.name: create-saving
scenarios.why: 'SAVING' with a rate of 0

scenarios.name: customer-deedited
scenarios.why: customer '1-2' (a separator typed): BIF DEEDIT leaves the digits, right-aligned: customer 12 is not on file -- CREACC 'N' / '1'

scenarios.name: type-missing
scenarios.why: no account type: 'Account Type should be ISA,CURRENT,LOAN,SAVING or MORTGAGE'

scenarios.name: type-invalid
scenarios.why: 'CHEQUE': WHEN OTHER, the account-type message

scenarios.name: rate-missing
scenarios.why: no interest rate (INTRTL zero): 'Please supply a numeric interest rate'

scenarios.name: rate-letters
scenarios.why: rate 'abc': fewer digit / point / sign characters than its length -- the numeric-rate message

scenarios.name: rate-two-points
scenarios.why: rate '1.2.3': 'Use one decimal point for interest rate only'

scenarios.name: rate-three-places
scenarios.why: rate '1.234': three digits after the point -- 'Only up to two decimal places are supported'

scenarios.name: rate-negative
scenarios.why: rate '-1': NUMVAL below zero -- 'Please supply a zero or positive interest rate'

scenarios.name: rate-too-high
scenarios.why: rate '10000': above 9999.99 -- 'Please supply an interest rate less than 9999.99%'

scenarios.name: overdraft-letters
scenarios.why: overdraft '000000ab': 'Overdraft Limit must be numeric positive int'

scenarios.name: customer-not-found
scenarios.why: customer 5 is not on the CUSTOMER file: CREACC 'N' / '1' -- 'The supplied customer number does not exist.'

scenarios.name: too-many-accounts
scenarios.why: customer 2 has ten accounts: CREACC 'N' / '8' -- '(too many accounts)'

scenarios.name: count-fails
scenarios.why: customer 9999999999: INQACCCU does not look that number up, CREACC 'N' / '9' -- 'unable to count accounts'

notes: CBSA's create-account screen (BNK1CAC, transaction OCAC, BMS map BNK1CA of mapset BNK1CAM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1CAM.bms, @bms/BNK1CAM.cpy). Pseudo-conversational: a first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the empty map; a returning one acts on the AID -- PA keys nothing, PF3 RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE (the task's terminal T001 is stated: oracle_assumptions.md X27), PF12 the termination message, CLEAR, ENTER, any other key 'Invalid key pressed.'. ENTER RECEIVEs the map (MAPFAIL abends HBNK through ABNDPROC), BIF DEEDITs the customer number and overdraft, validates the customer number, the account type (upper or lower case), the interest rate (digits, one point, two places, NUMVAL as COMP-1 between 0 and 9999.99) and the overdraft, then LINKs CREACC with SUBPGM-PARMS -- CREACC, INQCUST, INQACCCU and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-creacc -- and shows the new account or CREACC's failure. ACCOUNT, PROCTRAN, CONTROL, CUSTOMER and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. Every rate typed is exact in both IEEE and HFP (a binary fraction: 1.5, 3.25, 17.75 ...): FUNCTION NUMVAL into the COMP-1 INTRTI-COMP-1 is IBM's long HFP rounded to short in the det port and GnuCOBOL's IEEE float truncated on the MOVE to SUBPGM-INT-RT, which agree only on such values (oracle_assumptions.md C6). The COMMAREA is compared as the program RETURNs it, WS-COMM-AREA (the same 32-byte layout as its DFHCOMMAREA, which it reads back only for EIBCALEN). The overdraft is typed as all eight characters, as over the map's initial underscores: EDIT-DATA trims trailing spaces from its length with FUNCTION REVERSE / INSPECT LEADING, and a shorter typed value makes OVERDRL negative and the next INSPECT's reference modification (1:OVERDRL) undefined. Not reached: a customer number or overdraft with no digit at all (BIF DEEDIT of such a field is not modelled: refused), the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN / LINK (no fault can be injected on them) and CREACC's fail codes 2-7 that only a Db2 or ENQ failure gives (cbsa-creacc covers them). Data: seed.sql and customer.txt are SYNTHETIC (cbsa-creacc's).
